snippet.title: Pale Court Mod | Launch Trailer (Link in the description)
snippet.description:
The unofficial fanmade expansion, Pale Court, is now publicly available.
To download the mod:

1. Open mod installer (Scarab or HKMM)
2. Install the modding api (done automatically)
3. Search "Pale Court"
4. Click the install button

you can also use this direct download: https://themulhima.github.io/Scarab/commands/download/?mods=Pale%20Court (requires having scarab+ installed)

You can download scarab here: https://github.com/fifty-six/Scarab
You can download scarab+ here: https://github.com/TheMulhima/Scarab
If this is your first time installing a mod, we recommend this tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z35cFvU0McQ
Mod credits: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XP-eN3Gn3xVcYfzmkDtzKvA4jLTeuKKO25WF4pYQQJA/edit?usp=drivesdk
Video edited by redtreevortex, art by mebi, trailer music by Gauthier, trailer music vocals by Cavatina
Gauthier's channel: https://youtube.com/@pharloomsmusician-gauthier
redtreevortex's channel: https://www.youtube.com/@Redtreevortex
Cavatina's channel: https://youtube.com/@Cavatina
